propositions: The close precheck unconditionally invokes the completion provider verifier even when a valid, cryptographically certified completion-verifier PASS attestation already exists on the ticket bound to the exact target SHA.
A stored completion op-cert with authenticated verified-at-sha and material fingerprint matching the resolved close ref and current ticket state can be safely reused to skip provider dispatch.

The reuse decision must validate cryptographic authenticity of the stored attestation, equality of verified-at-sha to resolved close target, equality of material fingerprint to current state, and absence of post-attestation reopens.
Attestations that are missing, malformed, unverifiable, stale, differently pinned, invalidated by reopen, or lack required authenticated fields must fall through to fresh provider verification.
Reusing an eligible attested PASS must produce zero provider calls while preserving signed close output and durable completion evidence.
An explicit --ref CLI argument must reach the reuse decision through the normal close lifecycle path without bypassing the integrity checks.
